name: gooey-dropdown

frames.best_why: The menu is fully open with all four action rows readable in the pale panel.

tagline: A Share pill melts downward into a gooey menu panel, then snaps back.
summary: A compact Share button that opens into a menu through a liquid goo effect. The pill's rounded shape stretches into a larger panel listing actions, and clicking one or outside closes it.
appearance: A pale rounded Share pill on a dark stage. Open, it becomes a larger off-white rounded panel with four grey menu rows, joined to the pill by a curved neck; a row highlights when hovered.
behaviour: Clicking the pill runs a spring that stretches a gooey bridge downward as the menu grows, revealing item rows. Picking an item or clicking outside springs the whole shape back to the pill.
demo_content: Menu items Copy link, Send by email, Embed on site and Download PDF.
search_phrases: share button that opens a menu
use_when: A compact Share action needs a small menu that opens with a distinctive liquid motion.
avoid_when: The menu needs many items or nested submenus; the panel is a flat list with no scrolling.
customise: Set trigger text, the items array with per-item clicks, width, alignment, gaps, radii, fill colour, goo strength and spring. The layout below the button is fixed.
weight_why: A single animated clip path and one SVG goo filter; no loop runs.

a11y.note: Trigger and items are buttons with menu roles and Escape, but there is no arrow-key focus handling or reduced-motion path.

issues: Fully open, the panel floats away from the Share pill rather than reading as one dropdown.
The menu has no arrow-key navigation; rows only become tab stops once open.
polish_why: Convincing liquid morph; the open panel sits apart from its trigger and lacks arrow keys.
title: Gooey Dropdown
